rationale: With only 5 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk especially on a stock that gapped up 6.85% on news and is trading at 94% of its daily range near the high. The 1-minute candles show tight, low-volatility consolidation ($27.48–$27.58) with no clear directional momentum to exploit in the remaining time, and the risk/reward of entering at this stage of the session does not justify the execution risk.
